messages:
Raj Singh: Heads up — canary for merge in review-queue (PR#6789) shows a 9–12% p95 latency regression on long-seq workloads. Attaching quick bench output. Can someone triage and approve or request revert? @Emily @Marc

```bash
canary-run --bench longseq --model=rw-13B --tokens=2048
baseline p95: 310ms
canary p95: 340ms (+9.7%)
baseline p99: 520ms
canary p99: 580ms (+11.5%)
throughput: -6% at batch=8
```

Raj Singh: The change is in microbatching scheduling (scheduler.go). I suspect the new heuristic skips a small batch coalescing path under high interarrival variance.

Emily Chen: ack. pinging @Lina for the scheduler internals. Do we have perf flamegraphs?

Lina Park: can look in ~30min. Quick hypothesis: the sampler added per-request jitter; removing jitter in test drops p95 to 312ms. I'll run a focused canary.

Marc Lopez: FYI I left a review comment on the PR w/ a suggested fallback to old heuristic + feature flag. Would prefer patch instead of revert if we can validate.

Tony Nguyen: If this blocks the release, what's the cut-off? PM wants merge by EOD.

Raj Singh: Canary run started at https://canary.redwood.dev/runs/2948 — will update here. If Lina needs more time, we can hold merge to tomorrow morning. Not urgent for customer-facing hotfix.

infra-bot: Canary completed — metrics uploaded to grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/bench/longseq?panelId=5 — 9.7% p95 regression confirmed.

Lina Park: Ran targeted bench w/ removed jitter. New p95: 313ms. I pushed a small revert patch to my branch and ran canary; results look back to baseline. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/6792

Emily Chen: Can you open a small revert PR or add the flag behind a runtime gate? If you have metrics, we can approve the revert+followup. :thumbsup:

Marc Lopez: I'll approve the revert PR after CI passes. Also will add an integration test to catch sampler variance in CI.

Raj Singh: Thanks everyone. Please add a short note in the PR about perf measurements and we can merge once approvals + CI green. I'll coordinate the rollback if needed. :rocket:

Lina Park: pushed revert PR 6792, CI green locally, starting canary now — will post final numbers.
